rationale: Wind damage to the insured structure (roof shingles on back porch overhang) is a clear property_damage claim.
claim_summary: Wind damage on last weekend blew four shingles off the back porch overhang. Estimated repair cost is $400 with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Straightforward low-severity property damage claim.

case_facts.description: wind damage, four shingles blown off
